record.title: Reconcile the sole reboot request without issuing another reboot
record.intent: Determine whether the transport-timeout request caused a real boot and whether ordinary options survived.
requirements: Preserve the timed-out predecessor unchanged. Under fresh isolated capture maintain only the pinned private lease and wait up to120seconds for an ACK; do not repeat reboot or install commands.

Compare fresh boot identity to the sealed predecessor before epoch. A still-valid historical lease may support bounded read-only boot discovery if no fresh ACK arrives; changed boot without a fresh confirmed lease does not authorize further staging or root restoration.

If a fresh ACK and changed boot are established, allow at most one necessary adbd root restoration, require full stock UI and stable process over60seconds, exact protected license/key/vendor contents, unchanged identity/APK and ten ordinary statuses with BND false, then repeated cached17/17 with the fixed16-byte reader.
Preserve the observation gap explicitly and classify unchanged boot or uncertain state without another reboot. Seal raw capture, drop counters, before/after host state and independent evidence.
acceptance: The prior reboot and persistence are reconciled positively or the exact remaining uncertainty is recorded without repeating it.
